welcome_title: A little curiosity. A new understanding.
prompt_summarize: Summarize the key ideas in {{context}} of “{{title}}”.
prompt_explain: Explain the important terms in {{context}} of “{{title}}”, with everyday examples.
prompt_quiz: Quiz me on {{context}} of “{{title}}”. Ask one question at a time.
offline_title: A space to read. AI when you’re ready.
offline_body: Keep reading and organizing your documents. Connect an AI service whenever you want to explore them together.
general_welcome_body: Ask anything about your studies: plan, practise or understand a topic.
prompt_general_plan: Help me plan a focused study session. Ask what I am studying and how much time I have first.
prompt_general_explain: Explain a concept I am studying in simple terms, with everyday examples. Ask which concept first.
prompt_general_quiz: Quiz me on a topic I am studying. Ask which topic first, then one question at a time.
